[15] (a) in the public domain other than by a breach of this Agreement by the Receiving Party; or

[22] The Receiving Party shall maintain the Confidential Information with at least the same degree of care that the Receiving Party uses to protect its own similar categories of confidential and proprietary information, but no less than a reasonable degree of care under the circumstances.
[23] The Receiving Party shall not make any copies of Confidential Information except as necessary to perform hereunder.
[24] Each Party shall be responsible for any breach of this Agreement by such Party, its employees, agents, officials, representatives or consultants acting within the scope of their engagement or employment.
[25] 4. [33] The obligations of the Receiving Party under this Agreement shall survive the termination of this Agreement or the return of the Confidential Information to the Disclosing Party.
